description.zh: 需要删除的标签键。多项之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The label key to be deleted. To delete multiple label keys, separate them with commas (,).
The model ID. You can call [ListModels](~~461944~~) to obtain the model ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun aiworkspace delete-model-labels --model-id model-d8dfd0000sjfd --label-keys key1,key2 --region cn-hangzhou
